title: Record the dual-basis Gram identity
body:
## Summary
- The eight primal vectors and eight dual vectors in the rank-(9,9) equality example have Gram matrix equal to the identity, so `v · w = 1`.
- The stated ten term costs `(1, 7, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 1)` add to 72.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
